test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Humaneness**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Humaneness **means compassion, kindness, and the quality of being humane or considerate towards others. (करुणा, दया, और मानवीय होने या दूसरों के प्रति विचारशील होने का गुण)

 
 
• **Example: ***The rescue team demonstrated great humaneness by helping the stranded animals during the flood.*
 
 
 
• *​*The sentence sets up a parallel structure by first mentioning "faith in humanity" and then presenting "humaneness" as the corresponding quality that prevails.
 
• This creates a cohesive and balanced expression of the idea.

Thus, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Consciousness: **Awareness, the state of being conscious or awake, and having an understanding of one's surroundings or thoughts. (जागरूकता, सचेत या जाग्रत होने की अवस्था और अपने परिवेश या विचारों की समझ होना)
 
• **Frailty: **Physical or moral weakness; the quality of being fragile or delicate. (शारीरिक या नैतिक कमजोरी; नाज़ुक या नाज़ुक होने का गुण)
 
• **Animosity: **Strong hostility, hatred, or antagonism towards someone; bitter feelings. (किसी के प्रति तीव्र शत्रुता, नफरत या विरोध; कड़वी भावनाएँ)
